title: Velvety Soothing British Vanilla Victoria Sponge
description: A classic British dessert featuring vanilla extract and a hint of smokiness, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and grease two 8-inch round cake pans
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and smoked sea salt
In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to beat the eggs and sugar until light and fluffy
Add the softened butter to the egg mixture and beat until well combined
Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and beat until smooth
Divide the batter evenly between the prepared pans and smooth the tops
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean
Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely
Once the cakes are cool, use a serrated knife to level them if necessary
Place one cake layer on a serving plate and spread a layer of jam or preserves on top
Place the second cake layer on top and dust with powdered sugar
